label: An edit to a gene must be shown changing every node the map links that gene to
statement_en: The Boolean check closureB mapped changed is true exactly when every node in the mapped list occurs in the changed list; its truth implies the inclusion (closure_of_check), and a single mapped node absent from the changed list makes it false (closure_violated). Applied to the genotype map: a view that shows an edit to a gene changing fewer nodes than the map links to that gene is ruled out.

hypotheses.name: genotype-pleiotropy-closure#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: That the nodes the genotype map links a gene to are the nodes an edit may change: a bound on what a picture may omit, not a model of development.

hypotheses.name: genotype-pleiotropy-closure#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: That an unstudied node is absent from the map: the closure is only as complete as the sources behind it (ZFIN, Bgee), and the fin subtree is zebrafish anatomy.

hypotheses.name: genotype-pleiotropy-closure#assumed-3
hypotheses.statement: Nothing about magnitude: the check cannot say how much any node changes, or in which direction.

lean.source:
theorem closure_of_check {mapped changed : List String} (h : closureB mapped changed = true) :
    ∀ n ∈ mapped, n ∈ changed := by
  intro n hn
  have := List.all_eq_true.mp h n hn
  simpa [List.contains_iff_mem] using this

constraint_details.relation: every node the map links to the gene is in the set the edit changes
constraint_details.canEliminate: a Design Studio view showing a gene edit as a change to one structure when the map links that gene to several
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- A change set that omits a mapped node violates closure. -/
theorem closure_violated {mapped changed : List String} {n : String} (hn : n ∈ mapped) (hc : n ∉ changed) :
    closureB mapped changed = false := by
  by_contra h
  have := closure_of_check (Bool.of_not_eq_false h) n hn
  exact hc this
